backend: Transformers + PEFT, FP16, SDPA, batch size 1
instruction:
You control A. Reach a before B reaches b. B moves first each round,
always by a shortest path. The map shows walls (#), open cells (.),
runners A and B, goals a and b, an obstacle (X), and shared occupancy (*).
Each turn move one cell, wait, or place your single permanent obstacle
on an adjacent empty cell while keeping both goals reachable. Runners
may pass each other. Choose exactly one listed legal action and put it
inside <answer>...</answer>. Win +1, loss -1, timeout 0.

You choose A's action only. B has already moved. Copy one exact string from Legal actions, including its direction if present. Return it inside <answer>...</answer>. Use words, never an option number. Do not add an explanation.
invalid_output: Malformed or illegal actions execute wait and consume a turn. Unlike RAGEN, malformed output is not retried without advancing.
comparison_scope: Compare all three policies within this backend; never pool with RAGEN results.
tested_status: CPU helpers tested; Colab GPU execution not yet verified.
